channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump backs data centers in Ohio at Husted rally
item.description: Trump defended data centers powering AI projects, a contentious campaign issue, while rallying for Jon Husted in a tight Senate race.

item.title: Trump touts 'golden age' at Ohio rally
item.description: Trump urged Ohio rally-goers to "pretend I'm on the ballot" as he campaigned for Jon Husted and Vivek Ramaswamy in the midterms.

item.title: Supreme Court opens term amid legitimacy questions
item.description: The Supreme Court begins its new term with cases on gun rights, voter citizenship and religious liberty amid record-low public approval.

item.title: Southern Baptist president urges pastors to 'step up'
item.description: Willy Rice says pastors must "step up" on abortion, marriage, gender identity and immigration, calling these political issues deeply theological.
